name: MTG Card Search
author: bastos
description: Search Magic: The Gathering cards from the bar, with card images, prices, and a link to the full card page on Scryfall.

barWidget.description: Search Magic: The Gathering cards with the Scryfall API. Requests go to api.scryfall.com only while the panel is open, at most one a second, and results are cached for a day.

schema.label: Results shown
schema.description: How many matching cards the panel lists. Scryfall returns at most 175 per request.

schema.label: Sort by
schema.description: Order Scryfall sorts matching cards in.

schema.label: Show prices
schema.description: Show Scryfall's USD and EUR market prices under the card image.
